facebook.content:
The Kingdom doesn’t honor “busy”—it honors “purpose‑driven stewardship.”  
When we treat money as a servant, not a master, every dollar becomes a seed for God’s kingdom. Jesus said, “For where your treasure is, there your heart will be” (Matt 6:21). So our finances reveal where we place our devotion.  

What treasure are you guarding today, and how will you redirect it to honor the King?
